name: Olashyn the Twisted

abilities.name: Quick Strike
abilities.description: Basic melee attack dealing moderate physical damage.

abilities.name: Heavy Strike
abilities.description: Charged melee attack dealing moderate-high physical damage and staggering. This can be blocked to stagger Olashyn instead.

abilities.name: Powerful Throw
abilities.description: Olashyn starts an Uppercut-like attack but instead transforms into her weapon which flies in an arc and lands with force, dealing moderate-high physical damage in an area and staggering. This ability can only be cast one at a time between enemies.

abilities.name: Shard Shield
abilities.description: Olashyn channels a glass shield around her which grants her a moderate damage shield and deals moderate magic damage.

abilities.name: Bouncing Light
abilities.description: Olashyn launches a glass orb to her twin that bounces back to her, each time dealing moderate magic damage in an area.

abilities.name: Return, My Twin
abilities.description: If Olashyn isn't killed within two seconds of Ranishyn the Marred, Ranishyn is revived with 50% Health.

dialogue.speaker: Olashyn the Twisted
dialogue.trigger: When she revives her twin sister

When she revives her twin sister.speaker: Olashyn the Twisted
When she revives her twin sister.trigger: When she revives her twin sister

summary: Olashyn the Twisted is a Dremora who serves as one of the champions of the Leftwheal Trading Post alongside Ranishyn the Marred.
